title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover + load-shedding hysteresis
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Fixed a race in the SLO enforcer that could cause aggressive load-shedding during regional failover. Adjusted hysteresis to prevent cascading circuit-breaker trips. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Context: During a recent regional outage (SUP-7812) and subsequent failover we observed repeated cascade trips of the SLO enforcer: circuit-breakers would open, load-shedding would aggressively drop requests, and the regional failover logic retried immediately, amplifying pressure and causing extended outage windows. Root cause: ordering race between health-update propagation and queue-pressure sampling combined with an overly tight hysteresis window in the backoff logic.

This PR stabilizes the SLO enforcer by: 1) introducing message-order checks to ensure health/state deltas are applied in monotonic order, 2) widening hysteresis and adding jitter to the load-shedding backoff so nodes don't re-enter failover flooding simultaneously, and 3) making the regional-failover retry backoff pluggable and exponential with bounded cap.

Changes: (see commits)
- Add monotonic-sequence numbers to enforcer state updates and ignore stale updates.
- Tighten lock ordering around enforcer metrics snapshot and health marker writes to avoid stale samples being used for decisions.
- Increase default hysteresis window from 5s to 30s and add randomized jitter +-20%.
- Switch regional failover retry from fixed 1s to exponential backoff (base=200ms, cap=10s) with small initial jitter.
- Add integration test that simulates dual-region flapping and verifies single-failover path with no cascade shedding.

Testing: unit tests + new integration scenario added to perf-canary; replicated locally with 3-node test harness, observed stable failover path in 50/50 traffic reroute. CI and canary runs green.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests updated
- [x] Integration test added
- [x] Runbook updated (docs/runbooks/slo-enforcer-failover.md)
- [x] Backfill config schema default preserved for existing customers

Related: ENG-2045 tracked the incident investigation, SUP-7812 customer impact ticket.

Notes: This is a hotfix intended for rapid rollout; changes are backward compatible and gated behind a feature flag (slo_enforcer_hysteresis_v2) for staged rollout.
